non_claims.statement: No claim: no live TEI endpoint was contacted and none was validated; the HTTP surface is present but unproven (http_surface_present_unproven).
No claim: no retrieval-quality metric is asserted; embedding ranking quality is not measured by this packet.
No claim: no product runtime is provided; this is bounded repository evidence over crates/*/src and their test suites only.
No claim: the live TEI transport is cleartext HTTP without TLS and is not for untrusted networks; no TLS or authentication is implemented at this boundary.

No claim: canonical_string() provenance rendering is deterministic but not injective (source, license and parameter values are unescaped and not length-prefixed), so distinct provenances can render identically and the byte pin is not tamper-resistant.
No claim: the deterministic golden pin detects drift and is not a correctness proof; it does not validate embedding quality or legal correctness.
No claim: R012 enforcement stays scope-level; the settings source is a free string and managed-provider exclusion is not structurally enforced, only inventoried over crates/*/src.
No claim: the ln-testkit deterministic embedding port is shared test support, not a product provider and not published.
No claim: GATE-EMBEDDING-SUPPLY-CHAIN is not promoted; this packet is non-authoritative and gate_promoted/promotion are false.

decisions.summary: Embedding artifact and model-provenance contract lives in a serde-free, zero-dependency embedding_artifact module of crates/ln-storage, leaving EmbeddingPort/EmbeddingResponse/TeiEmbeddingAdapter unchanged.
Provenance is mandatory and typed; an embedding artifact without provenance fails closed with StorageError::MissingProvenance and no vector or provisional provenance is fabricated.

S01 provides a serde-free canonical string rendering of ModelProvenance with parameters sorted by key and a determinism test, so the provenance can be pinned later without committing to a wire schema.
Provenance attaches to embedding adapters through a new EmbeddingArtifactPort plus a reference ProvenancedEmbedding composition, without changing the existing EmbeddingPort seam.
The canonical rendering is deterministic but not injective (unescaped provenance fields); the byte pin it enables is explicitly not a tamper-resistant provenance proof.

The live TEI transport is a std-only HttpEmbeddingTransport over std::net::TcpStream with explicit connect/read/write timeouts and bounded response parsing; no reqwest/ureq/tokio/hyper and the ln-storage [dependencies] section stays empty.

Transport refusal is reflected at the TEI adapter boundary through closed typed unit variants StorageError::{TransportUnavailable,TransportTimeout,TransportBadResponse}; any transport failure returns Err and never fabricates a vector.
Server and legal response text never crosses the adapter boundary; failures map to the closed StorageError category before an EmbeddingResponse is created.

The deterministic embedding test port lives in crates/ln-testkit (publish=false) implementing ln_storage::EmbeddingPort and the TEI EmbeddingTransport seam; no embedding implementation is added to the product crate ln-storage and no dependency is added.

Reproducible test vectors use hand-rolled FNV-1a 64 seeding SplitMix64 with a tracked golden digest pin; no DefaultHasher, no rand and no transcendental functions, so two separate processes reproduce the bytes.

Malformed or hostile input is rejected by one closed additive variant StorageError::InvalidInput(&'static str) with static reason labels, bounded at MAX_DETERMINISTIC_INPUT_BYTES (64 KiB) and MAX_DETERMINISTIC_DIMENSIONS (65536).
The M215/S03 battery is implemented as ln-testkit integration suites run by the existing cargo test --workspace --offline CI step; no new slice-battery runner script is added.

The gate evidence packet is a tracked JSON artifact at prd/migration/rust-evidence/m215-s04-embedding-supply-chain-gate-packet.json, verified fail-closed by scripts/verify-m215-s04-gate-packet.py with red-green pytest; GATE-EMBEDDING-SUPPLY-CHAIN is not promoted (gate_promoted=false, lifecycle [bounded], authoritative=false).

canonical_string() non-injectivity is recorded as an explicit non-claim rather than hardened in S04; the gate-packet verifier requires the canonical-render-non-injective non-claim key so the limitation cannot silently disappear.
